## What EDNA is

EDNA is a behavioral-biometric human sensoric engine for AI recognition systems. It senses how a
human interacts — timing, movement, touch, rhythm, hesitation, corrections, scroll behavior,
reading pauses and message-writing dynamics — and converts those observations into quantized,
AI-readable signals so an AI can understand the human behind the session and adapt to the nature
of the person. EDNA is not positioned as a CAPTCHA or KYC replacement.

EDNA-1 runs 100% on-device in the browser sandbox for capture, scoring and classification. Raw
biometric data, message content, pointer paths and motion traces do not leave the device. The
only off-device transfer happens after explicit consent and carries quantized signals, scores,
descriptive context, hash patterns and/or chain exports — never raw biometrics.

## Product surfaces

- EDNA-1 engine SDK: `src/edna.js`, TypeScript definitions in `src/edna.d.ts`.
- EDNA ID chain: `src/edna-chain.js` — device-bound, append-only continuity layer.
- Adaptive Response Layer: `src/response-controller.js` — FLOW / FOCUS / EXPLORE / EXECUTE / REFLECT guidance.
- Writing-process channel: `src/edna-writing-process.js`.
- MCP server: live Supabase Edge Function `edna-mcp` (source: github.com/sebklaey/openos, `supabase/functions/edna-mcp/` + `supabase/migrations/0003_edna_mcp.sql`), local stdio server in `mcp/`, legacy Cloudflare Worker self-host in `deploy/`.
- React PWA frontend: `site/`, production build in `docs/`.
- Supabase backend: `supabase/migrations/` (0001–0003: schema, `edna-sync`, `edna-mcp`), legacy `supabase/schema.sql`.
- Stripe billing: credits and annual licenses through the EDNA Supabase endpoint.

## 16 EDNA-1 signal channels

Timing Distribution, Timing Entropy, Autocorrelation, Natural Drift, Path Curvature,
Speed Variation, Scroll Behavior, Device Motion, Contact Area, Click Duration, Reading Pauses,
Interaction Map, Motion Character, Corrections, Typing Bursts, Event Rate.

## MCP auth and metering

`POST /mcp` implements Streamable HTTP MCP. `initialize`, `ping` and `tools/list` are free.
Every valid `tools/call` requires a production customer account key (`edna2_…`):

`Authorization: Bearer edna2_...` or `X-EDNA-Key: edna2_...`

Free-Beta keys (`edna1_…`) were revoked at Go-Live (v1.4.1-main.1) and are rejected with
`beta_key_revoked`. Account keys are created at `https://fbxzacsslrrmivdzjctx.supabase.co/functions/v1/edna-mcp/` and shown exactly once.
The service stores only SHA-384 of the key. Loss of the key means loss of the account, credits
and licenses.

Metering: 1 credit per MCP tool call. An active annual license includes product usage.
Out-of-credits returns JSON-RPC error `-32042` with a top-up link.

## Commercial model

- Usage Credit: €0.01 per credit; 1 credit = 1 MCP tool call / API usage; minimum checkout pack 100.
- Professional annual license: €9.900/year — 1 production product, fair-use MCP/API/SDK, attribution seal.
- Business annual license: €29.900/year — up to 5 products / 1M MAU, usage included, priority support.
- Enterprise Resale annual license: €99.000/year — sublicensing/resale rights, unlimited end customers, SLA.

Stripe checkout is initiated through `POST /billing/checkout`. Stripe webhook events are
verified with the webhook secret and mirrored into the append-only CNSA-2.0 credits ledger.
No Stripe secrets belong in the frontend repository.

## EDNA credits ledger

`src/edna-ledger.js` records every purchase, grant, consumption and license purchase in an
append-only per-account hash chain:

- SHA-384 chain linkage over canonical JSON
- AES-256-GCM encrypted entry payloads
- HKDF-SHA384 per-account data keys
- ECDSA-P384 platform signatures
- ledger types: `purchase`, `grant`, `consume`, `refund`, `license`

## EDNA ID capabilities and honest limits

EDNA ID provides three continuity capabilities from one local chain:

1. Human sensoric over time — live, session and long-term memory versus the user's own history.
2. Continuous bot resistance — verification must keep growing organically across the session.
3. Same-human continuity — device-bound EDNA ID and reference-window resume.

Honest limits: 99%+ re-recognition is a research target requiring long-term field studies; the
chain alone does not stop a perfect mimicry bot; a hash proves continuity, never a real-world
identity by itself; new devices create new EDNA IDs by design.

EDNA ID Account tools (MCP `edna_identity_create` / `edna_identity_verify`): identity enrollment
requires ≥ 3 minutes of organic human-verified interaction (genesis still needs
`human_verified` at confidence ≥ 0.999), then seals a device-signed anchor block.
`edna_identity_verify` matches a claimed handle against the sealed commitment and live chain
windows; 3 consecutive 100 % matches authenticate the session (EDNA ID Account login), and every
successful login appends an `identity_login` growth segment — the chain keeps strengthening
while the user is logged in. All identity state stays on the user's device.

## Independent verification

- Harness: `node verification/run-tests.mjs`
- Independent functional suite: `node verification/independent-test.mjs`
- DOM observation test: `node verification/observe-test.mjs`
- Response-controller test: `node verification/test-response-controller.mjs`
- Writing-process test: `node verification/test-writing-process.mjs`
- Credits-ledger test: `node verification/test-ledger.mjs` — latest result 17/17 passed
- Identity suite: `node verification/test-identity-tools.mjs` — enrollment gate, device-signed
  anchor, 3× 100 % verify-to-login, login growth segments, revoke (10 checks); full suite
  197/197 across 6 suites
- Vectors: `verification/edna-test-vectors.json`
- Results: `verification/test-results.json`
- AI verification log: `verification/ai-verification-log.md`
- Browser demos: `/verify/`, `/field-test/`, `/chain/`, `/sensor/` on the official site `https://openos.space` (repository build in `docs/`)

## Deployment facts

The same React PWA is deployed at the official site `https://openos.space` (Lovable hosting, backed by
Supabase and Stripe). Frontend environment values:

- `VITE_EDNA_MCP_URL=https://fbxzacsslrrmivdzjctx.supabase.co/functions/v1/edna-mcp`
- `VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co`
- `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=YOUR-PUBLIC-ANON-KEY`

Supabase stores profiles, consent-gated chain snapshots and usage metadata under RLS. The
service-role key is used only inside the `edna-sync` Edge Function.
